mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_analysis_batches WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE material_analysis_batch_items SET upload_state = 'STAGED', message = NULL WHERE zip_entry_id = #{zipEntryId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND material_id IS NULL AND upload_state IN ('UPLOAD_FAILED', 'ABANDONED')

UPDATE material_analysis_batches b JOIN material_analysis_batch_items i ON i.batch_id = b.batch_id SET b.status = 'ANALYZING', b.finished_at = NULL WHERE i.zip_entry_id = #{zipEntryId} AND i.user_id = #{userId} AND b.status = 'FINISHED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_analysis_batch_items WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE material_analysis_batches SET status = #{to}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, NOW()) WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{from}

UPDATE material_analysis_batches b JOIN material_analysis_batch_items i ON i.batch_id = b.batch_id SET b.status = 'ANALYZING', b.finished_at = NULL WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.material_id = #{materialId} AND b.status = 'FINISHED'

UPDATE material_analysis_batch_items SET upload_state = #{uploadState}, material_id = #{materialId}, message = #{message}, est_min_seconds = COALESCE(#{estMinSeconds}, est_min_seconds), est_max_seconds = COALESCE(#{estMaxSeconds}, est_max_seconds) WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE material_analysis_batches b SET b.status = 'ABANDONED', b.finished_at = NOW() WHERE b.status = 'STAGED' AND b.created_at < #{before} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM material_analysis_batch_items) i WHERE i.batch_id = b.batch_id AND i.material_id IS NOT NULL)
